newsitem.title: FRANCE: Warner to take stake in CanalSatellite-paper.
newsitem.headline: Warner to take stake in CanalSatellite-paper.

text.p: Warner Bros will announce plans to take a 10 percent stake in Canal Plus's digital channel business CanalSatellite for between 500 million and 800 million francs, the newspaper La Tribune reported on Monday.

It said, without naming sources, that Warner would also acquire Compagnie Generale des Eaux's CGV cable activity as part of the deal, which it described as a first step toward a wider alliance of Canal Plus, its main shareholder Havas, and Warner.
It said Warner would announce plans to buy into CanalSatellite in the next few days.
Officials at Canal Plus were not immediately available for comment on the report.

La Tribune said the deal, "which will entail a reduction of Canal Plus's stake in its subsidiary, is estimated at between 500 million and 800 million francs, given a valuation of five to eight billion francs for the digital channel offering".
CanalSatellite, which has 300,000 subscribers, is 70 percent held by Canal Plus, 10 percent by Generale des Eaux and 20 percent by Pathe. -- Paris Newsroom, +33 1 4221 5452
